name: qa-parallel-dashboards
description: Two-wave parallel QA + fix of every StayHaven dashboard. Wave 1: platform, hotel admin, reception, waiter. Platform then processes wave-1 change requests. Wave 2 (based on qa/platform): kitchen, super admin, guest, public. Then a final platform REQ pass and a consolidated report.

branches.prompt: WAVE 1 of 2. Read d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\00-common-rules.md, then read and fully execute d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\01-platform-security.md. You are session 01 (platform). Three other agents (hoteladmin, reception, waiter) run in parallel with you and file change requests in d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\requests\*.md; process them as the prompt says. Kitchen, superadmin, guest and public run in wave 2 AFTER you, on top of your qa/platform branch, so prioritise shared fixes they depend on (auth/session, client.js interceptors, socket auth, BillPreviewModal, ConfirmDialog, errorHandler, orderController). Work only in your own worktree and branch, commit only there, never push or merge. Stop your background servers when done (rules K). Finish by writing your report to the path in the prompt.

steps.prompt: You are session 01 (platform), between wave 1 and wave 2. Read d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\00-common-rules.md and d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\01-platform-security.md, then your own report d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\reports\platform-report.md. Wave 1 (platform, hoteladmin, reception, waiter) has finished. 1) Make sure no wave-1 dev servers are still running on ports 3000-3003 / 5173-5176 (stop leftover node/vite processes started from d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.worktrees\qa-*; don't touch anything else). 2) Process every request still marked 'status: open' in d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.agents\tasks\qa-parallel\requests\*.md on branch qa/platform in d:\hotel-booking-order-management-system\.worktrees\qa-platform (P0 first), with tests, replying in-line with 'status: done in <sha>' or 'rejected – reason'. 3) Run lint, build, frontend tests and backend tests in that worktree and record results. qa/platform must be green (no new failures vs baseline), because wave 2 branches from it. 4) Append a 'Between waves' section to platform-report.md listing what wave 2 inherits. Never push or merge.

Run git diff --stat for each qa/* branch against qa/platform and list files touched by more than one branch (expected conflicts). Don't change any code. Factual, no filler.
